items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: And it was just a pleasure to play for her and watch her.

ctx.x: She came in doing the same act. He just didn't understand it. For $75 a week, he couldn't understand it.

For $1500, he thought -- this is what tickles me about people that know. Pearl was a natural, she knocked me out, getting out in the middle of the floor, doing, 'It's a Long Way to Tipperary.' And she had a way of -- like, her brother was a great dancer. Her hands would keep a beat, her little palm, she palmed the beat with her hands. And it was just a pleasure to play for her and watch her.
So those were the kind of people that were in the Vanguard.
